method.blocks: Exactly8 consecutive250-successful-update blocks per arm, all three seeds retained
method.missing: BCE/Dice and other unrecorded components remain null; total loss is not decomposed retrospectively
method.timing: Loss/fields describe accepted pre-update forward; gradient maxabs after backward, before optimizer step; gate norms after update
method.gradients: Per-parameter-TENSOR maxabs only; None, exactzero and positive values remain distinct; not channel-wise gradient vectors
method.branch_observations: Eight extra branch weight/bias maxabs scalars are recorded; no branch weight norms, parameter changes or gradient vectors are reconstructed. These gradients combine ordinary F0 and conditional D paths
method.paired: AR-control losses compared at identical sample-plan steps; this describes whole learned trajectories, not instantaneous attribute causality
method.interpretation: Random patch composition changes between blocks; slopes and late loss do not certify convergence or justify extending training
